COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
UKHC010015362026
WPSS/260/2026
Jyoti Chauhan --Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand & others --Respondents
Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
Mr. Vinod Tiwari, learned counsel for 
the petitioner. 
2. Ms. Swati Verma, learned Brief Holder 
for the State. 
3. There is no dispute that the petitioner 
is resident of Uttarakhand, which is evident 
from Annexure 1, the petitioner has not been 
offered appointment only because of the 
reason that he has done his D.El.Ed from 
State of U.P. 
4. It is very surprising that the authorities 
are comparing the Permanent Resident 
Certificate with Common Resident 
Certificate though both are distinct. Even 
otherwise as per the Government Order 
issued by the State of U.P. dated 08.02.2003
the Common Resident Certificate are meant 
for those who want to get admission in any 
institution. 
5. Let the District Education Officer may 
reexamine the issue and apprise to this Court 
on 25.11.2026
6. Put up this matter on 25.11.2026.
7. Personal appearance of the officer for 
the time being is exempted. 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
